parameters.name: CertId
parameters.description: The ID of the certificate. This parameter is required if you set CertType to cas.

parameters.name: CertName
parameters.description: The name of the certificate. You can specify only one certificate name. This parameter is optional if you set CertType to upload.

parameters.name: CertRegion
parameters.description: The region of the certificate. This parameter takes effect only when **CertType is set to cas**. Valid values: **cn-hangzhou** and **ap-southeast-1**. Default value: **cn-hangzhou**. **ap-southeast-1** is recommended for users on the International site.

parameters.name: CertType
parameters.description:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

- **upload**: custom certificate

- **cas**: a certificate that is acquired through Certificate Management Service.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SSL certificate. The type of request supported by the domain name must be HTTPS. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

parameters.name: SSLPri
parameters.description: The private key. Specify the private key only if you want to enable the certificate.

parameters.name: SSLProtocol
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL certificate.

- **on**

- **off**

parameters.name: SSLPub
parameters.description: The certificate content. Specify the certificate content only if you want to enable the certificate.
